stem: Two angles are supplementary. The measure of the larger angle is \(24^{\circ}\) more than 3 times the measure of the smaller angle. What is the measure, in degrees, of the larger angle?
solution: Let \(s\) and \(t\) be the smaller and larger measures: \(s + t = 180\) and \(t = 3s + 24\).
verify:
s, t = symbols('s t')
sol = solve([s + t - 180, t - (3*s + 24)], [s, t])
assert sol == {s: 39, t: 141}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[t]]
